## Summary

Describe the problem and the proposed change.

## Validation

- [ ] `python -m pytest`
- [ ] Package build/check completed when packaging changed
- [ ] English and Chinese documentation updated together
- [ ] No checkpoint, benchmark JSONL, generated artifact, secret, or private paper source added
- [ ] New `.py` and `.sh` files include the required Apache-2.0 SPDX header

## Compatibility

Describe effects on public APIs, checkpoint loading, benchmark contracts,
artifact formats, reproducibility, licensing, or data provenance. Write “None”
when not applicable.

## Security

Do not include vulnerability details in a public pull request. Follow
`SECURITY.md` for private reporting.
